adjudication.finding: Mandate section 7 defines the direct route as as-traded close_t x point-in-time as-reported shares_t. In the data, as-reported share counts are dated at the FILING, not at the origin. When a split falls between the filing date and the origin, multiplying a post-split price by a pre-split share count is itself a mixed-basis error — the exact error class G0 exists to remove.

worked_example.external_reality: AMZN's market capitalization on 2022-06-30 was approximately 1.07 trillion USD
worked_example.conclusion: the incumbent is right and the literal direct route is 20x too small on this cell

adjudication.algebraic_identity: A time-aligned direct route must restate shares onto the origin's basis: shares_at_origin = shares_raw x product of splits between the filing date and the origin. Multiplying that by the as-traded close, which is the adjusted close x product of splits after the origin, yields adjusted_close x shares_raw x product of splits after the filing date — which is the incumbent construction exactly. Correctly specified, the two routes are identical, not merely close.
adjudication.what_G0_actually_established: The R2/R3 market-cap construction is already basis-consistent. The mixed-share-basis defect that overturned R0 (back-adjusted price against as-reported shares, up to 40x, 274 of 848 cells) is absent here: 1,618 of 1,638 cells are identical to machine precision, and all 20 differences are the incumbent correctly restating shares across a split that the literal control leaves unrestated.
adjudication.verdict_qualification: Recorded together with the literal C1 result, which failed at one origin. The threshold was not moved, the control's defect was not discovered by looking at whether it helped, and the identity above is checkable independently of any measurement. If the owner reads the literal contract as binding regardless of control validity, the alternative label is G0_INCONCLUSIVE and the remedy is to re-run C against the time-aligned direct route, whose outcome is determined in advance by the identity.
adjudication.consequences_for_later_gates: C3 and C5 remain unmeasured. Under the identity they are also determined — a time-aligned direct size control is the incumbent size control, so the R3 coefficients cannot move. Step D is therefore reduced to a confirmation run, not an open test.
